title: Request for information on dealer installation manuals
not_questions: Adobe Analytics is excluded from the proposed scope.
Use metric dimensions on every trial manual.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Explain how AEM Sites would move multilingual valve installation guides from Drupal while keeping existing serial number links valid.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Describe how AEM Sites would let an engineer correct a torque setting across manuals without changing discontinued model specifications.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Show how AEM Sites would restrict an export distributor to the safety instructions approved for its sales territory.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Specify the AEM Sites acceptance checks for a printed QR code that points to the latest approved guide for a particular valve.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe how Acrobat Sign would collect a distributor's acknowledgement of revised flange assembly instructions and record the exact revision signed.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how Acrobat Sign would route an acknowledgement to the correct Salesforce account when two dealers use the same trading name.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Provide the Acrobat Sign exception process when the designated dealer signatory is away during a safety recall.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Identify the Acrobat Sign evidence an auditor would use to trace an acknowledgement back to the issuing engineer.

questions.label: B.5
questions.text: Explain the Acrobat Sign handling of distributor acknowledgements already in circulation when a revised safety notice supersedes the previous form.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Name the people responsible for technical publication and distributor training on your delivery team.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide one reference for a manufacturer that publishes safety revisions across an independent dealer network.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: State your lead time for adding a technical translator and describe how you verify that translator's engineering experience.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Explain your pricing assumptions for an additional distributor territory after the first handover.
